cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; An open observation bridge over a ringed-moon transit line — She watches an empty tram pass below while eating the last piece of a boxed sweet she bought on the way home; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — holds her keepsake at chest height; A private orbital guest suite with late-morning light coming through a curved roof window and a faint planetary horizon — She plays a quick solo Go exercise using a travel board before her next appointment; a riverside seating area waiting for festival fireworks — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — seated on a chair; a starship galley and mess hall — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — crouching low on her heels; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — seated on a chair; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing with one foot up on a step; a small bakery workroom with a floury wooden worktable and warm ovens — types a message on a smartphone with both thumbs; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her
